worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.summary: Take the target trick-or-treating: dress it in a Ghost shell by adding the Ghost type -- Normal and Fighting cannot touch it, while Ghost and Dark strike it hard, until the shell tears off.
worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.use.0: dress a target as a Ghost with a Ghost/Dark weakness
worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.use.1: shut down a foe that relies on Normal or Fighting
worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.use.2: pair with Foresight to strip the shell's Ghost immunity
worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.descripti: Add the Ghost type to the target for %1$s: while dressed it counts as Ghost for same-type bonus and damage taken - Normal and Fighting cannot touch it, while Ghost and Dark strike it hard; the type reverts when the shell expires or is removed early. Only a non-Ghost Pokemon with fewer than three types and no type-locking ability can be dressed.
worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.grand.on: Grand: %1$s wind-up and %2$s cooldown buy a longer shell and denser decorations.
worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.grand.off: Light: shorter shell, faster wind-up and cooldown, good for dressing often.
worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.descripti: Dress range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s; a blocked line of sight stops the cast.
worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.trickortreat.preferenc: Grand: shell x1.6, but +4 wind-up and +20 cooldown; off is a shorter, faster, cheaper shell. Only 20 PP.
The companion only considers Trick-or-Treat within this distance of a threat; lower stays close, higher chases further.
When on, it will leave its post to dress the target.
world_combat.move.trickortreat.text.dres: Dressed in a Ghost shell (%1$s s)
world_combat.move.trickortreat.text.noro: Already Ghost or type layer full, no room for a shell
